`solve_model` still passes `n.snapshots`, and `_as_model_snapshots` returns that index unchanged whenever the model is not flat. If a model is built with MultiIndex snapshots and the network’s snapshots are subsequently changed to a single-level index before calling `solve_model`, the callback receives the single-level index rather than the model’s MultiIndex representation. Thus the conversion does not guarantee the criterion for every network and call path.
